description: Conduct deep research on complex topics using iterative multi-step analysis with Gemini. Runs grounded search passes on a fast model, then synthesises them with Gemini 3.1 Pro. Default 2 passes (2-3 minutes); more passes take proportionally longer. [MCP_RECOMMENDED_TIMEOUT_MS: 900000]

focus_areas.description: Optional: specific areas to focus the research on

max_iterations.description: Number of grounded search passes (1-10, default 2). A synthesis step runs after 2+. Claude Desktop: 2-3 fits its 4-minute timeout. Agent SDK / IDEs (VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf) / Cline: 5-7 for deeper coverage.

model.description: Omit to use the defaults: gemini-3.8-flash for the search passes, gemini-3.1-pro-preview for synthesis. Setting this uses one model for both.

research_question.description: The complex research question or topic to investigate deeply

name: gemini_deep_research
title: Gemini Deep Research
